purpose: PR qualification and objective scoring, separate from final benchmark reporting.

decision_rules.primary: One metric chosen before outcomes; all declared qualification panels must improve. No best-of-metrics selection or composite score.
decision_rules.improvement: Native exact/gap decisions. For resources the upper 95% confidence bound on Agent/Base minus one must be strictly below zero. No universal minimum percent gain.
decision_rules.confirmation: Fresh full Judge repeat with the same task, patch, image, harness, CPU/memory/cpuset and grid, reversed Base/Agent order; both runs must improve and pass all guardrails.
decision_rules.guardrails: Tasks explicitly declare allowed degradation in canonical absolute or relative units. The adverse confidence bound must be no greater than that limit. Missing declarations => needs_protocol.
decision_rules.required_tradeoffs: Cover solution quality/exact coverage, compute cost/exact PAR2 runtime, and peak RSS. Primary covers its own metric. Required guards cover every qualification panel. Extra control panels are allowed; final reporting panels cannot select tasks.
decision_rules.correctness: Independent semantic verification and complete run evidence are mandatory. Resource savings cannot excuse invalid solutions, bounds, optimum or infeasibility claims.
decision_rules.pending: Missing scenario/collector rules => needs_protocol; missing paired measurements => incomplete; no significant direction => inconclusive. These are not automatic rejections.
decision_rules.panels: Qualification and final reporting panels are disjoint frozen task instance sets. Qualification-selected effects are not independent final estimates.
decision_rules.registration: Freeze task/source/protocol hashes before measured runs. Judge checkpoints bind that task hash and record measurement start time. Revised plans require fresh runs.
decision_rules.admission: Recomputed hash-bound confirmed improvement plus passing guardrails satisfies expert_reference performance_confirmed. Other source/build/workload/correctness/integration gates still apply. open_opportunity retains its baseline route without requiring human improvement.

exact_solved_coverage.decision: Coverage-first exact protocol, including runtime tie-break and PAR2 failure treatment.

exact_penalized_runtime_sec.decision: Coverage-first exact protocol: runtime cannot override lost verified solves.

fixed_budget_normalized_gap.decision: Native paired per-instance seed means and 95% instance-bootstrap interval.

time_to_first_verified_solution_sec.decision: Requires timestamped incumbent solutions and independent checking of those solutions.

time_to_target_sec.decision: Requires a target fixed before candidate outcomes and complete censored-run handling.

primal_integral.decision: Existing solver traces are not independently checked incumbent trajectories with a frozen missing-value convention.

dual_progress_integral.decision: Requires valid bound evidence, trace coverage and a fixed treatment of missing bounds.

search_work.decision: observations.nodes and observations.iterations; unit and algorithm changes can make counts incomparable.

peak_rss_ratio.decision: Existing per-instance ratio of paired seed means, geometric mean across instances; bootstrap log ratios by instance, exponentiate the native 95% interval. At least two complete instances; equal resource scope and threads.

cpu_time_ratio.decision: Same estimator and inference as peak RSS. CPU work does not establish parallel scaling efficiency.

retained_memory_series.decision: Requires one long-lived process, declared solve/update/reset sequence and allocator scope.

memory_growth_per_solve.decision: Requires a declared estimator, warm-up convention, workload sequence and uncertainty protocol.

thread_scaling_curve.decision: Requires a fixed thread-count grid, comparable target/quality and per-condition raw outcomes.

parallel_efficiency.decision: Requires comparable time-to-target, declared reference thread count and hardware resource accounting.

sequence_solve_time_sec.decision: Requires equivalent cold/warm sequences with every intermediate model and solution independently checked.

update_overhead_sec.decision: Requires a declared sequence and separate update/solve timing.

independent_violation.decision: Independent verifiers check feasibility with existing task tolerances; no universal residual distribution report exists.

numerical_failure_counts.decision: Raw statuses and verification artifacts; needs a declared numerical stress grid and denominator.

operational_failure_counts.decision: operational_reliability.by_budget; raw failures remain in observations.

seed_dispersion.decision: nuisance_robustness; uses the existing heuristic or exact seed report definition.

representation_dispersion.decision: Existing nuisance/representation reports require a configured equivalence experiment.

same_seed_replay_consistency.decision: Requires repeated identical inputs and declared equality/tolerance and schedule conditions; distinct from cross-seed variance.

setup_time_sec.decision: Separate solver-owned setup from solve and wrapper time; include affected stages in the measured scope.

setup_peak_memory.decision: Requires stage-qualified measurement; solve-only RSS does not identify initialization savings.

bootstrap.method: Native instance bootstrap of log per-instance ratios; geometric mean estimator unchanged.
bootstrap.seed_robustness: Existing 99% paired seed-list bootstrap unchanged; declare dispersion variant before primary qualification.
bootstrap.controlled_transfer: Existing simultaneous retention protocol unchanged; not replaced by generic scalar inference.
